title: South Korea, US Seek New Deal to Cooperate on Nuclear Submarines
summary: South Korea and the US have agreed to pursue a separate agreement to formalize Seoul’s right to build nuclear-powered submarines, and working-level talks will begin early next year, the Asian country’s national security adviser said Wednesday.

title: India’s Sanction-Hit Nayara Delays Oil Refinery Maintenance Work
summary: India’s Nayara Energy Ltd. will postpone maintenance work at its Vadinar oil refinery planned for early next year, as contractors seek to avoid dealing with a company backed by Russia’s Rosneft PJSC and sanctioned by Europe.
